## Delivery Note

**ITEM:** S4c-A1, the Injured status art (**samples, enemies only**), from `drafts/planning/S4c-injured-status.md` (#120). Folder: `incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/`. Everything is generated by script (`source/make_injured.py`, `source/make_injured_preview.py`). No blood, bones, cracks or red. Gentle and hopeful.

**Main preview:** [every enemy: plain / Injured idle S, E / move N / wind-up fade](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/review-2-enemies-idle-then-windup-fade-2x.png)

**WHAT:**
- **Overlay sheets for each enemy** (`sprites/<enemy>/<enemy>_<layer>_<anim>.png`). Each has the same frame size, 8-direction rows and frame columns as that enemy's own sheets, so they share its anchor.
  - **swarmer, shield, brute, padded (Bouncy Bopper):** `idle`, `move`, `windup`
  - **keeper:** `idle`, `move`, `windup_slam`, `windup_sweep`
- **Layers:** `injured-stars-back` goes under the enemy; `injured-bandage` and `injured-stars-front` go over it. Soft yellow and warm white stars with a gold-brown outline circle the head; a cartoon plaster cross sits on the forehead corner, away from the eyes.
- **Stars stay at head height:** the orbit sits below the head-top line, which is the top of the idle silhouette, moved with the body in each frame. No star goes above it, and every star stays inside the frame. `make_injured.py` checks every frame of every star layer: **1904 frame-layers, 0 above the line or out of bounds.**
- **Boss variant:** the Floor Keeper uses the same art with **2 stars**, and so do Guardians, by rule (`injured.json` → `starCount`; set `STARS[<id>] = 2` when Guardian sheets exist). The other enemies have 3.
- **Wind-up fade (code rule, `windupFade`):** during a wind-up the stars drop to **50%** alpha over 4 ticks and come back after it. The bandage stays at full strength, and the S11 tell is untouched.
- **Wobble (code rule, `wobble`):** ±3° around the ground point, 1.6 s period, in idle and move only. It stops during a wind-up.
- **"Shake it off" puff:** `sprites/fx/injured-puff_shake-off.png`, 8 frames at 128×128 and 16 fps, played on `injuredEnd`.
- **"Injured!" pop-up:** `sprites/fx/injured-popup_plate.png` (176×56), a cream pill with a bandage icon and **no text baked in**. The game writes the word in its UI font in `textArea`.
- **Wording goes to S4c-C1 (Content).** "Injured!" is the spec's decided word and is used in the preview only; C1 owns the final text and the Sensei and Bestiary lines (`injured.json` → `wording`).

**Previews:** [main: enemies + wind-up fade](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/review-2-enemies-idle-then-windup-fade-2x.png), [pop-up + puff](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/review-3-popup-and-shake-off-puff-2x.png), [scene 1x](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/review-4-scene-1x.png), [scene at phone width, 390 px](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/review-4-scene-phone-390px.png), [greyscale](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/greyscale-2-enemies-idle-then-windup-fade-2x.png). The player layers and player previews were removed (enemies only).

**Second pass:**
- The head finder used the idle pose to ignore raised arms and the staff in wind-ups.
- The stars now orbit at head height and are clamped inside the frame; the automatic check passes on every frame.
- The keeper's bandage was sitting on its crown, so it's now lower on the hood.
- Greyscale is readable, and the phone-width scene reads.

**DECIDE:** none for art. The wording is C1's.

**NEXT:** Programmer (S4c-P1): draw the layers while `injuredTicks > 0`, apply the fade and wobble, use the 2-star sheets for bosses, show the pop-up on `injured` and the puff on `injuredEnd`.
